breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth specifies treating the arc load as an inward pressure, not a vertical traction. The generated specification incorrectly instructs to 'Apply a uniform vertical traction t = (0, -20 000) Pa on the curved arc', which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt.
